# 📋 Pixel Task List

An offline, pixel-style task list built with vanilla HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. No dependencies, no network requests, no storage—everything lives in memory.

## Features

- Add tasks (trims whitespace; blank input is ignored)
- Toggle completion via checkbox
- Delete tasks
- Live counts: total tasks and incomplete tasks
- Keyboard accessible (Tab, Enter, Space)
- Responsive from 360px wide

## Usage

Open `index.html` in any modern browser. Type a task and press **Enter** or click **Add**. Check the box to mark complete; click **✕** to delete.

## Structure

- `index.html` — markup with required IDs
- `style.css` — pixel-art theme (4-color palette)
- `script.js` — in-memory state and event handling

## Constraints

No external assets, no storage, no server. All state resets on reload. Source under 240 lines.
